title: One-room school restart curriculum
summary: Restarts basic education during long disruption using safety, literacy, math, memory, and practical skills.
content: One-room school restart curriculum is a practical offline routine for education restart. Divide the day into safety briefing, reading, writing, math, local memory, hygiene, and supervised practical work. Teach mixed ages together while avoiding turning older children into all-day caregivers. Use real tasks as lessons: water counting, food inventory, map reading, plant records, and tool safety. Keep play, art, and rest because stress damages learning. Record attendance, progress, concerns, and missing children.
